name: Defender sporting blaster pistol
description: Defender sporting blaster pistols, also known simply as a Defender Pistol, were a type of blaster pistol favored and used as a sidearm by Leia Organa. She first learned to shoot the Defender as a pre-teen, and displayed a rare talent for shooting. She stunned a mutinous Poe Dameron with one aboard the Raddus. Amilyn Holdo, whose command Dameron had overthrown, carried a Defender pistol.
